title: Update vendored dr_wav from v0.13.7 to v0.14.5
description:
## Summary

- Updates the vendored `dr_wav` single-file C library from v0.13.7 (2022-09-17) to v0.14.5 (2026-03-03)
- No breaking API changes — all existing wrapper code in `src/dr.cpp` compiles and works without modification
- Package passes `R CMD check` (the only test failure is a pre-existing missing `patrick` package, unrelated to this change)

## Test plan

- [x] `devtools::check(cran = TRUE)` passes (compilation, examples, tests)
- [ ] Verify on CI
